ctx: 영화 「I Don't Understand You」(2025, American dark comedy horror thriller set in rural Italy). Nick Kroll as Cole and Andrew Rannells as Dom, a gay married couple from Los Angeles celebrating their 10th anniversary in Italy while waiting to adopt a baby boy from birth mother Candace (they were scammed in a previous adoption). Dom's father's friend Daniele gives them engraved kitchen knives ('Domenico' and a misspelled 'Cool') and books a dinner at Zia Luciana's remote farmhouse restaurant near Orvieto. Their rental car gets stuck in the mud in the rain; a gruff man in a truck (Massimo) whose driveway they block drives them to the farmhouse, hitting a deer on the way. Luciana, a nearly blind old woman, serves pizza, homemade wine and horse meat (Cole is a vegetarian); her son Giovanni (gay) died last year and her husband is on a ventilator. Power goes out, Luciana falls down the cellar stairs and dies after their clumsy CPR; Massimo returns, finds his mother, shouts in Italian, they stab him in a panic (he was actually congratulating them on becoming fathers), they revive him, Candace calls that her water broke; Massimo's fiancee Francesca flees and is hit by their car; Luciana wakes up; they burn the evidence in the pizza oven and drive to the airport. Police find the bones and the 'Cool' knife, chase them at the airport only to return their passports. They get their baby in Pittsburgh and name him Gio (after Giovanni). Epilogue: second adoption interview video. Italian dialogue in the film has burned-in yellow English subtitles.
